The disobedient machines in the hydroponic farm aren't enough. I need something more.
I have a bad feeling about this...
strings.냐하하하. 왔어요? 잘 왔어요! 반가워요! 너무 반가워요!!: Nyahaha! You're here? Wonderful! Welcome! I'm so, so happy to see you!!
strings.흑흑…. 그동안 얼마나 보고 싶었는데, 찾아주지도 않고. 거의 10년 동: Sob... I've missed you so much, and you never visited. Did you know it's been almost ten years?
Huh? Ten years? I'm not falling for that.
strings.쳇. 비련의 히로인을 받아주지도 않고 말이야, 이거 서운한데요. 냐하하하: Tch. You won't even humor a tragic heroine. I'm hurt. Nyahaha.
I heard you wanted to see me.
strings.요즘 사라스바티만 찾고, 나는 찾아주지도 않고 그래서 심통 났어요. 뿌우: You only visit Sarasvati these days. You never come to see me, so I'm sulking. Hmph!
strings.마침 심심하기도 하고. 내가 죽는다면 심심해서 죽을지도 몰라요!: Besides, I'm bored. If I ever die, it'll probably be from boredom!
You sound just like someone I know...
strings.그렇구나. 나랑 비슷한 사람이 있구나. 그래서 말인데요. 내가 너무 심심: Oh, so there's someone like me. Anyway, I'm so boooored. Being stuck in this dull place with Warsam and Kerberus is so tiiiiresome.
strings.윽, 말 길게 하지 말아주세요. 부탁이에요. 기분이 축 처지는 것 같아서: Ugh, please stop dragging out your words. I'm begging you. It's draining all my energy...
strings.헤헤, 그래서! 부탁드리고 싶은 게 있어요! 최근에 멋진 돼지들이 많다는: Hehe! Anyway, I have a favor to ask! Sarasvati told me you recently visited a place full of wonderful pigs!
Well, actually, I just happened to sneak a look at her protocol...
Freya, I didn't realize how frightening you were...
strings.꺄핫♡, 전 사람이 아닌걸요. 사람 취급해주셔서 감사!: Ahaha♡ I'm not a person, though. Thanks for treating me like one!
strings.하아, 그건 그렇고 그 모로스 지역에 있는 멧돼지들이 왜요?: Sigh. Anyway, what about the wild boars in Moros?
strings.그 돼지들을 잡아다 주세요!: Catch them and bring them to me!
strings.엥, 전혀 모르겠는데!: Huh? I don't understand at all!
strings.헤헤, 더도 말고 덜도 말고 그 동네 필드에 돌아다니는 멧돼지 30마리를: Hehe. No more and no less than thirty of the wild boars roaming around that area, please♡
strings.그러면 이 수경 농장이 재미있어질 거 같아요!: They'll make this hydroponic farm much more fun!
strings.괜찮아요! 어차피 녀석들 말 안들으면 회로를 다 뜯어놓을 거니까요!: It's fine! If they don't listen, I'll rip out all their circuits!
strings.다녀오시면 제가 왜 그러는지 말씀드릴게요. 모험가님도 들으시면 이해하실: I'll tell you why when you get back. You'll understand once you hear it, Adventurer! Nyaha!
strings.흠, 의심스럽긴 하지만 한번 다녀올게요. 그럼 제대로 이야기해줘야 해요!: Hmm. I'm suspicious, but I'll go. You'd better explain properly!
strings.이 멧돼지들을 어디다 쓰려고 잡아 오라고 한 거예요?: What exactly are you planning to do with all these wild boars?
strings.(프레이아에게 잡아온 힐디스비니 여러 마리를 안겨준다.): (You hand Freya several of the Hildisvinis you caught.)
strings.헤헷, 헤헷. 이 얼마나 아름답고 훌륭한 자태를 가진 멧돼지인가?: Hehe, hehe. Such beautiful, magnificent wild boars!
strings.나 알지? 내가 주인님이야!: You know me, right? I'm your mistress!
Right, I'll give you new names! I've forgotten all the old ones.
You're Goldie, you're %s, and you're Numbskull...
I think I heard my name in there...
Tch. %s was such a good name for a boar... I almost got away with it... (Mumble, mumble.)
Now tell me why you wanted the boars, like you promised.
Not enough. There aren't enough pigs...
I need the ones in other cooolors. Aww.
strings.더 많은 멧돼지들을 잡아오라고요?: You want me to catch more wild boars?
strings.빙고! 역시 %s 님! 다른 색을 가진 다른 멧돼지 두 종을 더 잡아오시: Bingo! That's our %s! Bring me the other two kinds of boars in different colors, and I'll give you my autograph!
I don't need your autograph. Just tell me why.
strings.사라스바티가 모르는 이야기를 하나 해드릴게요! 그럼 됐나요?: I'll tell you a story even Sarasvati doesn't know! How's that?
If you don't want to, I can't make yooou. Teehee.
All right. I'll go. But promise me this is the last time.
Forty wild boars, as promised... Here you go.
This should be enough for the little ones to live comfortably here.
strings.그러면 약속대로 이야기해줄래요?: Will you tell me now, as promised?
strings.약속은 약속이니까 이야기해줄게요!: A promise is a promise, so I'll tell you!
These little ones originally came with the people of Asgard.
We raised them as a kind of emergency food supply.
strings.(프레이아 앞에 있던 힐디스비니의 표정이 잔뜩 굳어진다.): (The Hildisvini in front of Freya goes stiff.)
strings.냐하하하, 겁먹지 마! 어차피 여기서 너희들을 먹을 인간도 없…. 아,: Nyahaha! Don't be scared! There aren't any humans here to eat you anyw... Oh, there's one right here.
strings.배에 구멍이 나면서 돼지들이 슈웅~하고 우주 밖으로 날아가 버려서…. 아: A hole opened in the ship, and whoosh! The pigs went flying out into space... I thought that was the last I'd ever see of them.
strings.그런데! 우하하하. 시간이 얼마나 흘렀지? 그 아이들의 아이들의 아이들의: But! Wahahaha! How much time has passed? Their children's children's children...
strings.아뇨. 그 아이들의 아이들의 아이들의… 그런 건 줄 알았는데, 그냥 그: No! I thought they were their children's children's children's... Well, their descendants. But they're the very same pigs!
strings.그 아이들이면 그때의 아이들이란 거예요?: The same pigs from back then?
strings.넹! 처음엔 그냥 돼지들이나 키워야지 했는데, 자세히 보니 그때 그 아이: Yep! At first, I just thought I'd raise some pigs. But when I looked closer, it really was one of my old little ones! We parted so long ago. How could they be unchanged?
Look how nice and plump they've gotten! I'll raise lots of them and...
strings.(프레이아 앞에 있던 힐디스비니가 잔뜩 긴장한 표정을 지어보인다.): (The Hildisvini in front of Freya looks extremely nervous.)
strings.잔뜩 키워서 수경농장에서 타고 다녀야지. 냐항♡: Raise lots of them and ride them around the hydroponic farm! Nyah♡
strings.가는 길에 이슈타르 언니한테 인사하고 가요~. 안 그래도 할 말이 있나: Say hello to Big Sis Ishtar on the way out. I think she has something to tell you. Nyaha! Stop right there, you pigs!! I'll catch you all and teach you a lesson☆
strings.오랜만이야. 최근에 아주 바빴었지?: It's been a while. You've been very busy lately, haven't you?
strings.대충 어떤 일들이 있었는지는 사라스바티를 통해 들었어. 어쩌면 우리가 관: Sarasvati gave me a rough idea of what happened. We may be involved somehow, yet I haven't paid enough attention.
It's all right. I appreciate the thought.
We'll do more to help you from now on. I promise.
strings.이건 너를 위해서도, 우리를 위해서도 중요한 일이거든. 어쩌면 이 세계의: This matters both to you and to us. It may even reveal the truth of this world...
strings.그 아이에게도 안부 전해줘. 네가 그토록 찾던, 이 세상을 구할 수 있는: Give my regards to that girl, too. The one you searched so hard for, who can save this world...
Ah, I suppose she's this planet's goddess now.
strings.하여튼, 앞으로도 넌 너만이 할 수 있는 일을 해줘. 우리는 우리대로 널: Anyway, keep doing the things only you can do. We'll find our own ways to help you.
Thank you. I'll be going, then.
strings.어, 그래. 오랜만에 봤는데, 성격이 꽤 급해진 것 같네…. 벌써 가고: Oh, all right. It's been a while, but you seem to have gotten rather impatient... Leaving already.
strings.꺄하하하! 나 잡아봐라! 이 돼지들. 왜 이리 도망가! 냐하하항!♡: Ahahaha! Catch me if you can! You pigs, why do you keep running away? Nyahaha!♡
strings.저 모습을 보기 싫어서 일찍 간 거라고 믿어야겠군. 끙. 은하대전의 기록: I'll assume the desire to avoid that sight is why you left so soon. Ugh. I wonder if any records of the Galactic War remain...
strings.(프레이아가 힐디스비니를 잡으러 미친 듯이 뛰어다니고 있다.): (Freya races wildly around, trying to catch the Hildisvinis.)
strings.신경쓰이긴 하지만, 프레이아가 저 정도로 날뛰는 건 오랜만이니 내버려둘까: It's distracting, but it's been a long time since Freya was this lively. I'll leave her be.
strings.냐하하항!♡ 다시는 헤어지지 말자냥!: Nyahaha!♡ Let's never be separated again, meow!
